svg.title: Panpipes E3 to E4, strip edge, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Panpipes, E3 to E4, strip edge, sheet 1 of 1: edge strip. 1.5mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Blue #0000ff engraves the plugs' places on the front plate, on the plates' outside faces, which lie face up. Then orange #ff8000 cuts the slots, and black #000000 frees the parts.
